package.name: alix_tasks
package.description:
The task layer for alix: the MoveIt Task Constructor executors, scene builders and config reader, plus the task DATA they run on — fixture scenes and meshes, cleaning-point configs, mechanism/glove/bin task definitions, and task parameter defaults.
Ported from butterfli `cleaning_tasks` on 2026-08-16 (plan/P13). The config tree landed first and the C++ followed; this manifest grew back with it, as the data-only note here said it would.
MoveIt2 and MoveIt Task Constructor come from the ROS 2 Jazzy debians, declared below and resolved by rosdep — not vendored and not built from source. See plan/P13.3: the binaries are the same releases the two out-of-tree home-directory builds carried.
Consumed by `alix_taskgen` (which resolves this package via ALIX_TASKS_PKG or a repo-marker search) and by the Gazebo worlds, whose `model://alix_tasks/...` URIs resolve through GZ_SIM_RESOURCE_PATH.
